now.text: finishing Wavelength, a music recommender that runs in your browser.

paragraphs: I'm a computer science graduate from Hyderabad. I work as an AI engineer at Navatej Technologies, remotely, and I spend the rest of my time building the products on this page: machine learning, computer vision and full applications, each one published with the numbers behind it.

I come from a family of doctors in Kurnool. My parents run a small nursing home and my younger brother is studying medicine. I'm the one who went into computers, and a lot of what I want to build is for people like my parents' patients: tools that just work, on whatever device they have.
I like finishing things properly. If I start something, I learn it, plan it and take it all the way, and I would rather publish the bad number than hide it.

facts.label: Education
facts.text: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering, Mahindra University, Hyderabad, 2022–2026. CGPA 9.19. Academic Scholarship all four years.

facts.label: Before
facts.text: Technical Head of the Computer Vision Club at Mahindra University, 2024–25, and a poster on object detection for traffic surveillance at the MICA conference, 2024.

outside: Guitar, drawing, the gym, my mother's garden, films with the family every evening, learning to cook, snooker.
